style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium glossy lip colour visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless cool white #FFFFFF, pearl grey #F0EFEC, one lavender accent #8C84B4 and charcoal text #1B1B1D; neutral-cool bright soft beauty lighting with a front-left key, sweeping wet highlights on gloss and skimming light only on texture details, soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with short label lines; thin-line square tick boxes and blank number chips as the only icon language; stable slim upright tube scale and a straight-on or slight 3/4 product angle; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no shade numbers or efficacy claims invented
